meta.title: Session Manager
meta.description: List every session and delete one without touching the others; deletions go to a trash you can restore from, the deletion policy is enforced server-side, automatic cleanup honors the same policy, and queued deletions require confirmation by default. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2.

title: Session Manager
intro: Delete a single session (its log, projection cache, and sidebar reference). Deletions go to a trash and can be restored.
liveHint: This session is in use by the running process; deleting it now would recreate it immediately. Switch to another session first, or queue it for deletion.
pendingHint: These sessions are not deleted silently at startup; confirm and run them from the panel.
unreachable: Cannot reach the plugin backend: {error} (on the desktop app you may need to restart once after installing the plugin)
backup: The log moved to the trash below and can be restored from there.
